title: Kill the console windows that flash open on app boot
description: On Windows, every app boot pops ~10 terminal windows for a second. Two causes: (1) Vision's own child_process calls omit windowsHide:true, and the server.js Electron fork has no console, so Windows allocates a conhost per console child - 4x wmic win32_videocontroller, 2x nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name, 2x bare nvidia-smi, plus the polled nvidia-smi VRAM read; (2) @cubric/connector spawns the broker CLI with BOTH detached:true and windowsHide:true, and Windows IGNORES CREATE_NO_WINDOW when DETACHED_PROCESS is set, so the broker node process shows a console regardless. Reads as malware to users. Connector half lives in c:/AI/Mpi/Cubric-Studio/packages/connector/src/.
